Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, aur quick location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/wellfood

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Well Food, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Well Food) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha near Patliputra Sports Complex. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, and quick location directions.
